subject: Labelling a clade using geom_cladelabel produces an error

messages.author: 072b80adfb4bbbd5
messages.subject: Labelling a clade using geom_cladelabel produces an error
parts:
First, thank you for making ggtree, it is incredibly helpful for my research. 

I am able to plot my tree correctly, however I would like to label a clade of a tree (node 839 in this case). When I try to add a geom_cladelabel for the specified node, I get an error:

mytree<-midpoint(originaltree)

MRCA(mytree, tip=c('A51', 'A4'))

ggtree(mytree, ndigits = 2, ladderize = FALSE, layout="rectangular") %<+% plasmidtable + geom_tippoint(aes(color=subtype), size=3) + scale_color_manual("subtype",values = plasmidcolors) + geom_text2(aes(subset=!isTip, label=node), hjust=-.3) + theme(legend.position=c(0.2, 0.2), plot.margin=unit(c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5),"cm"), legend.key = element_rect(fill = 'gray90', colour = 'gray90', size = 0.5), legend.title = element_text(colour = 'black', size = 20, hjust = 3, vjust = 7,face = 'bold'), legend.text = element_text(colour = 'black', size = 10, hjust = 3, vjust = 3), legend.background = element_rect(fill = 'gray90')) + guides(col = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) + scale_x_continuous(expand = c(.2, .2)) + geom_cladelabel(node=839, label="something")


[1] 839
Warning: Ignoring unknown aesthetics: subset
Warning: Ignoring unknown aesthetics: subset
Warning: Ignoring unknown aesthetics: node, parent
Warning: Ignoring unknown aesthetics: node, parent
Error: stat_clad_bar requires the following missing aesthetics: xend, yend


I am using the most recent version of ggtree (). If you would like I can set up a test/example dataset/R script and upload that as well if you think it would be helpful.

Thanks!
